name: Cliffs of Moher
lore: The Cliffs of Moher: Tir Urphost on the plateau, the sea at the foot of the cliffs, and the fog. The Grey Man - the Fear Liath, the fog that wrecks ships - has made a bargain: he hides Norse longships in his fog and brings them in under the cliffs, and every death they cause is his. And the fog isn't his alone. It rolls in from the east.

chains.title: The Cliff Dwellers' Hold
chains.hint: War-cries from the cliff dwellers' hold above the ravine...

stages.name: Clear Cliff Dwellers' Hold
stages.objective: Clear the cliff dwellers' hold
stages.announce: The cliff dwellers are massing at their hold above the ravine - paid in Norse silver to keep the coves clear. Break them before they come up onto the plateau.
stages.success: You have cleared the cliff dwellers' hold. Fomhor the Cliff Chief comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the cliff dwellers' hold. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Fomhor the Cliff Chief
stages.objective: Defeat Fomhor the Cliff Chief
stages.announce: Fomhor the Cliff Chief stands at the cliff dwellers' hold. Bring friends.
stages.success: Fomhor the Cliff Chief falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Fomhor the Cliff Chief slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Cliff Dwellers Hold the Road to Tir Urphost
stages.objective: Drive the cliff dwellers off the road to Tir Urphost
stages.announce: With The Cliff Dwellers' Hold lost, the cliff dwellers have spread down onto the road to Tir Urphost and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The cliff dwellers are gone from the road to Tir Urphost. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Aine, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Aine has come out to set the road to Tir Urphost right. The cliff dwellers are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Tir Urphost is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The cliff dwellers break and scatter. The road to Tir Urphost is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Aine falls, and the cliff dwellers take the road back.

chains.title: Fog on the Cliffs
chains.hint: The fog is rolling in over the moor, and the beacon is guttering...

stages.name: Protect Sorcha the Beacon-Keeper
stages.objective: Protect Sorcha the Beacon-Keeper, who is keeping the beacon alight
stages.announce: The Grey Man's fog is rolling over the moor, and the wraiths are in it, coming to put out the beacon. Sorcha won't let it go out - help her.
stages.success: "That's done," says Sorcha the Beacon-Keeper. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Sorcha the Beacon-Keeper falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear Beacon
stages.objective: Clear the beacon
stages.announce: They came from the beacon. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the beacon. The Fog Banshee comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the beacon. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Fog Banshee
stages.objective: Defeat the Fog Banshee
stages.announce: The Fog Banshee stands at the beacon. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Fog Banshee falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Fog Banshee slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Fog Wraiths Hold the Road to Tir Urphost
stages.objective: Drive the fog wraiths off the road to Tir Urphost
stages.announce: With Fog on the Cliffs lost, the fog wraiths have spread down onto the road to Tir Urphost and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The fog wraiths are gone from the road to Tir Urphost. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Ruadh, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Ruadh has come out to set the road to Tir Urphost right. The fog wraiths are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Tir Urphost is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The fog wraiths break and scatter. The road to Tir Urphost is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Ruadh falls, and the fog wraiths take the road back.

chains.title: The Moheran Distorters
chains.hint: Sentinel Cathal is gathering the watch to go to the distorters' rift.

giver.name: Sentinel Cathal
giver.greet: The air out east is twisting - the distorters have opened a rift, and things are coming through. We're going to close it. With us? Tell me when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Good. Stay close - they will have watchers out. With me!
giver.busy: We've only just come back. Give my people a while to rest, then find me again.

stages.name: The Road to Distorters' Rift
stages.objective: Go with Sentinel Cathal to the distorters' rift
stages.announce: Sentinel Cathal leads the sentinels of Tir Urphost to the distorters' rift.
stages.success: Sentinel Cathal reaches the distorters' rift. "There they are. Clear them out!"
stages.fail: Sentinel Cathal falls on the road. The others carry the body home.

stages.name: Clear Distorters' Rift
stages.objective: Clear the distorters' rift
stages.announce: Clear the distorters' rift!
stages.success: You have cleared the distorters' rift. The Great Distorter comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the distorters' rift. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Great Distorter
stages.objective: Defeat the Great Distorter
stages.announce: The Great Distorter stands at the distorters' rift. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Great Distorter falls. Tir Urphost will hear of this in the taverns tonight.
stages.fail: The Great Distorter slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Moheran Distorters Hold the Road to Tir Urphost
stages.objective: Drive the moheran distorters off the road to Tir Urphost
stages.announce: With The Moheran Distorters lost, the moheran distorters have spread down onto the road to Tir Urphost and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The moheran distorters are gone from the road to Tir Urphost. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Cormac, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Cormac has come out to set the road to Tir Urphost right. The moheran distorters are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Tir Urphost is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The moheran distorters break and scatter. The road to Tir Urphost is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Cormac falls, and the moheran distorters take the road back.

chains.title: The Siege of Moher Watchtower
chains.hint: Smoke at Moher Watchtower: Norse raiders on the watchtower road!

merchant.name: Quartermaster Maible
merchant.greet: While Moher Watchtower stands, I can sell you what coin won't buy. Marks of Valor only.

stages.name: Hold Moher Watchtower
stages.objective: Keep Sentinel Cinead alive while the storm-spirits attack the tower
stages.announce: A Norse raiding party has come up the watchtower road and is battering at the gate! Sentinel Cinead calls for every sword nearby.
stages.thanks: "The tower holds! Drinks are on me when the quartermaster isn't looking."
stages.success: The storm-spirits break off the attack. Moher Watchtower holds.
stages.fail: Moher Watchtower has fallen to the storm-spirits.

stages.name: The Norse Hold the Watchtower
stages.objective: Drive the Norse out of Moher Watchtower
stages.announce: The Norse hold Moher Watchtower and its beacon is dark. Hersir Gunnvor is looting it - drive them out.
stages.success: The Storm-Rider is dead and the tower is ours - for now. They will be back.

stages.name: Hold the Gate
stages.objective: Keep Sentinel Cinead alive until the garrison is back
stages.announce: Sentinel Cinead is raising the realm's colours again - and the storm-spirits are coming back for the tower!
stages.thanks: "Moher Watchtower is ours again. The quartermaster will be glad to see you."
stages.success: Moher Watchtower is held by the realm again. Its garrison and quartermaster are back.
stages.fail: Sentinel Cinead falls, and the storm-spirits take the tower back.

chains.title: The Koalinth Landing
chains.hint: The koalinth are coming ashore on the south-west rocks...

stages.name: Clear Koalinth Landing
stages.objective: Clear the koalinth landing
stages.announce: The koalinth have come ashore below the cliffs and are building a landing. Throw them back into the sea.
stages.success: You have cleared the koalinth landing. Koalinth Tidecaller comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the koalinth landing. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Koalinth Tidecaller
stages.objective: Defeat Koalinth Tidecaller
stages.announce: Koalinth Tidecaller stands at the koalinth landing. Bring friends.
stages.success: Koalinth Tidecaller falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Koalinth Tidecaller slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Koalinth Slinkers Hold the Road to Tir Urphost
stages.objective: Drive the koalinth slinkers off the road to Tir Urphost
stages.announce: With The Koalinth Landing lost, the koalinth slinkers have spread down onto the road to Tir Urphost and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The koalinth slinkers are gone from the road to Tir Urphost. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Fiona, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Fiona has come out to set the road to Tir Urphost right. The koalinth slinkers are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Tir Urphost is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The koalinth slinkers break and scatter. The road to Tir Urphost is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Fiona falls, and the koalinth slinkers take the road back.

chains.title: The Longships
chains.hint: Longships in the fog under the cliffs!

stages.name: The Landing
stages.objective: Throw the Norse landing party back into the sea
stages.announce: Longships have come out of the fog into the middle cove under the cliffs, and the Saltwolves are coming ashore! Throw them back before they get up the ravine!
stages.success: The landing party breaks - and their hersir jumps down from the prow to rally them.
stages.fail: The Norse are ashore. Their raiding parties are already climbing the ravine.

stages.name: Hersir Ketil Saltwolf
stages.objective: Defeat Hersir Ketil Saltwolf
stages.announce: Hersir Ketil Saltwolf wades ashore with an axe in each hand. 'The fog-man promised us an empty coast. Liar.' Bring friends.
stages.success: Ketil Saltwolf goes down in the surf. His crews drag him to the ships, and the longships back off into the fog.
stages.fail: Ketil rallies his crews on the shingle.

stages.name: The Norse on the Shingle
stages.objective: Burn the Norse camp on the shingle
stages.announce: The Norse have a camp on the shingle of the middle cove, and their raiding parties are loose on the cliff paths, the fields and the watchtower road. Burn them out!
stages.success: The camp burns. The longships pull away into the fog.

chains.title: Fetch-Night
chains.hint: Faces in the fog at Tir Urphost's edge - faces everyone knows...

stages.name: The Doubles
stages.objective: Keep Druid Tobryn alive while he sings the fetches away
stages.announce: Fetches are walking into Tir Urphost out of the fog - doubles of the townsfolk, every one smiling. Druid Tobryn is singing them back to the dark. Keep them off him!
stages.thanks: "Gone. All of them. I counted my own face three times tonight."
stages.success: The fetches fade - all but one, tall and grey, that doesn't look like anyone in town.
stages.fail: The singer falls, and the fetches walk into the houses.

stages.name: the Grey Man's Fetch
stages.objective: Destroy the Grey Man's Fetch
stages.announce: The last fetch is the Grey Man's own double, come to see who's stopping him. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Grey Man's Fetch tears like a fog bank in the wind. The town breathes out.
stages.fail: The fog closes over Tir Urphost.

stages.name: The Fetches Walk Tir Urphost
stages.objective: Drive the fetches out of Tir Urphost
stages.announce: The fetches walk Tir Urphost's lanes, and the townsfolk have shut themselves in. Drive them out!
stages.success: The last fetch fades. Doors open again.

chains.title: The Wreckers' Lights
chains.hint: Lights moving along the cliff tops - and a Hibernian ship out in the fog...

stages.name: The False Lights
stages.objective: Stop the cliff dwellers carrying the false lights along the cliffs
stages.announce: A Hibernian ship is feeling its way along the coast in the fog - and cliff dwellers are carrying lanterns along the cliff tops to lure her onto the rocks. Stop the light-bearer!
stages.success: The light-bearer drops his lantern and it goes out. Far below, the ship's bell rings: she's turning for open water.
stages.fail: The ship follows the lights onto the rocks.

stages.name: the Wrecker-Chief
stages.objective: Defeat the Wrecker-Chief
stages.announce: The wreckers' chief, a cliff dweller with a sack of Norse silver on his belt, comes up the cliff path for whoever spoiled his night. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Wrecker-Chief falls. His sack spills Norse silver over the rocks.
stages.fail: The Wrecker-Chief gets away along the cliffs.

chains.title: The Aughisky Run
chains.hint: Hoofbeats on the moor, and the smell of the sea...

stages.name: The Water-Horses
stages.objective: Drive the aughisky off the moor before they carry anyone into the sea
stages.announce: The aughisky have come up out of the sea onto the moor - water-horses that let you ride them, and then ride you into the waves. Drive them off!
stages.success: The herd scatters - and the herd's stallion comes out of the fog, kelp in its mane.
stages.fail: The water-horses run back to the sea with riders on their backs.

stages.name: the Kelp-Maned Stallion
stages.objective: Defeat the Kelp-Maned Stallion
stages.announce: The Kelp-Maned Stallion, father of every aughisky on this coast. Bring friends.
stages.success: The stallion falls, and the moor is quiet.
stages.fail: The stallion runs back into the sea.

chains.title: Burn the Longphort
chains.hint: The Watch is gathering a war band on the cliff top above the longphort.

giver.name: Watch-Sergeant Aedan
giver.greet: Jarl Hrafn's longphort sits in the north-west cove like a tick on a dog. Four at least - bots and all - and when you're ready, say [burn the longphort].
giver.reply: Down the cliff path! Mind the bowmen on the stockade - straight through to the jarl's hall!
giver.thanks: The longphort burns. The cove is ours.
giver.regret: Back up the cliff! We'll come again.

stages.name: The Shingle
stages.objective: Storm the shingle under the bowmen on the stockade
stages.announce: Onto the shingle! Norse bowmen on the stockade - clear the beach and the gate!
stages.success: The gate's down. Inside, by the beached longships, Jarl Hrafn is waiting with his huscarls.
stages.fail: The war band is driven back up the cliff.

stages.name: Jarl Hrafn
stages.objective: Defeat Jarl Hrafn in his hall
stages.announce: Jarl Hrafn, raven on his shield: 'The fog-man gave me this coast. I keep what I'm given.'
stages.success: Jarl Hrafn falls among his ships. The Watch puts the torch to the longphort, and the Cliff Beacon is lit above the cove.
stages.fail: Hrafn drives the war band back into the sea-fog.

chains.title: Ulf Sea-Wolf
chains.hint: A red sail in the fog: the jarl's brother has come back for the cove.

stages.name: The Beacon
stages.objective: Keep Beacon-Keeper Niamh alive at the Cliff Beacon
stages.announce: Longships in the cove! Every Norseman Ulf could find. Hold the beacon!
stages.success: The first rush breaks - and Ulf Sea-Wolf jumps down onto the shingle.
stages.fail: The beacon is thrown down.

stages.name: Ulf Sea-Wolf
stages.objective: Defeat Ulf Sea-Wolf
stages.announce: Ulf Sea-Wolf, Hrafn's brother: 'You burned my brother's hall. I'll build a bigger one on your bones.'
stages.success: Ulf falls. The cove holds - for now.
stages.fail: Ulf takes the cove back and the longphort rises again.

siege.name: the Longphort
siege.open_text: Hear me! The Watch of Moher means to burn Jarl Hrafn's longphort out of the north-west cove! Watch-Sergeant Aedan waits on the cliff top above it. If no one leads within the half-hour, the Watch goes without you.
siege.taken_text: The longphort is burning! The Watch holds the north-west cove and the Cliff Beacon is lit - go and see.
siege.repelled_text: The attack on the longphort has been thrown back. The Saltwolves grow bolder.
siege.raid_text: A red sail in the fog: the Norse are coming back for the cove!
siege.held_text: The Norse are thrown back into the sea. The cove holds.
siege.fall_text: The cove has fallen. The longphort is rising again, and the Watch must rebuild its resolve.
siege.carry_text: The Watch leads you down the cliff path at a run.
siege.carried_cry: The war band wouldn't wait any longer - the Watch has stormed {0}!

camp_npcs.name: Watch-Quartermaster Fiachna
camp_npcs.greet: Cove-only stock, for those who burned the longphort and those who hold the beacon.

camp_npcs.name: Healer Brigid
camp_npcs.greet: Brews from Tir Urphost, carried down the cliff on my back. Coin, mind.

camp_npcs.name: freed thrall
camp_npcs.idle: Two years at the oar. Two years. I'd forgotten what land smells like.

camp_npcs.name: Beacon-Keeper Niamh
camp_npcs.greet: The Cliff Beacon's lit. Every ship on this coast can see it now - ours and theirs.
camp_npcs.idle: Watch the fog. When it thickens and there's no wind, they're coming.
